certificate.domain: nonzero support {1,10,18,25}; normalized base uses N=1 or norm(p,q,r,s)=2

global_frame.normalization: F=G*D^(-1/2), using positive square roots; F^T F=I20
global_frame.polynomial_action: L_x*G=R*diag(Delta I4,p I4,q I4,r I4,s I4)

certificate.global_unit_model: Y={(x,z) in S3 x S19: Delta*z_cone=0; ell_i*z_i=0 for i=1..4}
certificate.kernel_completeness_dependency: eight-sector all-real rank theorem on the fixed support
negative_controls: unscaled approach step fails its extreme target
certificate.proof_scope: Analytic log-coordinate and constructive density proofs establish smoothness, connectedness and exact closure; polynomial identities certify the global incidence homeomorphism using the prior rank theorem.
certificate.remaining_scope: Whitney conditions, finite triangulation, homology, all 32 coefficient directions and all-dimensional classification require separate proofs.
